name: Kharon Black Iron
passives: Dominion Flame: decisive aggression turns enemy weakness into momentum.
lore: Kharon Black Iron is a colossal Infernal Dominion Titan shaped by power belongs to those capable of wielding it. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Obsidian, hellfire, dark iron, chains, burning sigils, horn-lineage anatomy, ash-fire skin, volcanic cracks. The silhouette must be colossal, non-human, readable on mobile, and unmistakably Infernal Dominion.
developmentStatus: Playable data scaffold complete; artwork pending.
